ns2:course.label: Impl High Perf Work Systems
ns2:course.description: Intensive analysis of all aspects of high performance work systems, including work design, reward systems, training, team operations, lean/six sigma systems, and labor-management partnership. Special focus on skills and principles for effective implementation, in ways that advance employee well-being and to organizational effectiveness.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Human Res & Industrial Rels major(s).
